reason: Refuted: the code grows by 103 bytes, and the gameplay disc's build cannot take them. The old window (DE66-DEAA) is 69 bytes and the new one is 172, so hazel_b_end moves up by &67. In the shipping build that is DF65 -> DFCC, under the E000 ASSERT. But the gameplay disc (build/strykers-gameplay.lst, the GAMEPLAY_*+DITHER_HILLS+HUD_RUPTURE build) puts level_movers_x_low, ground_columns and rup_k_lo/hi in hazel_b after sky_col_check, and there hazel_b_end is already DFFF, one byte free. With the change it would be E066, and src/game.6502:6321 'ASSERT hazel_b_end <= &E000' fails, so that build breaks. The candidate's '52 bytes left' holds for the shipping build only. The rest checks out on the machine lens. Every opcode is valid 65SC12 (STX abs, STZ abs, INC A). The carry chain is right: C=1 after SBC sky_t and after SBC #8 (n>=15, since sky_heights gives 23/26/28 and L is 0-7), and after each SBC #&02 (rh is &40-&7F). At .top, CMP #8 rewrites C, so C coming in as 1 on the fall-through does not matter. The two BCC top branches (from ~DEBE and ~DEE9 to DF12) are in range but cross a page and pay +1 when taken. Recounted cycles in the window: old 147/211/275 and new 116/168/214 for 2/3/4 entries, saving 31/43/61. Moving the split loop wholly into page DF also saves about 2 cycles per split iteration. The 61 used below is the 4-entry best case.
